title.narrative: ILO - DEVELOPING CAPACITIES TO ADVANCE DECENT WORK FOR ALL
ILO - SVILUPPARE LE CAPACITÀ DI PROMUOVERE IL LAVORO DIGNITOSO PER TUTTI

description.narrative: Contributo volontario all'ILO (Organizzazione Internazionale del Lavoro), organizzazione dedicata a promuovere la giustizia sociale e i diritti umani e del lavoro riconosciuti a livello internazionale, perseguendo la sua missione fondante secondo cui la giustizia sociale è essenziale per una pace universale e duratura. Le aree di lavoro dell'iniziativa consistono nell'ampliare l'accesso e le capacità per un'occupazione produttiva e liberamente scelta e per un'impresa sostenibile; rafforzare le transizioni giuste e la dimensione sociale dello sviluppo sostenibile, del commercio e degli investimenti, della protezione sociale e della costruzione della resilienza; affrontare la disuguaglianza, la discriminazione e l'esclusione. Aiuterà anche a realizzare i diritti del lavoro come diritti umani, garantendo la dignità umana e la soddisfazione dei bisogni primari; rafforzare le istituzioni del dialogo sociale; la migrazione della manodopera; l'innovazione e lo sviluppo di partnership tecnologiche. Il contributo all'iniziativa è coerente con l'attuazione dell'Agenda 2030, in particolare con l'SDG 4 (Garantire un'istruzione di qualità inclusiva ed equa e promuovere opportunità di apprendimento permanente per tutti) obiettivi 4.3 e 4.4; e l'SDG 8 (Promuovere una crescita economica duratura, inclusiva e sostenibile, un'occupazione piena e produttiva e un lavoro dignitoso per tutti), obiettivi 8.5, 8.6, 8.7. Il contributo contribuirà all'SDG 3 (Garantire vite sane e promuovere il benessere per tutti a tutte le età); all'SDG 5 (Raggiungere l'uguaglianza di genere ed emancipare tutte le donne e le ragazze); all'SDG 9 (Costruire infrastrutture resilienti, promuovere l'industrializzazione inclusiva e sostenibile e promuovere l'innovazione) e all'SDG 10 (Ridurre l'ineguaglianza all'interno e fra i Paesi). Altri SDG coinvolti sono l'SDG 12 (Garantire modelli di consumo e produzione sostenibili); l'SDG 16 (Promuovere società pacifiche e inclusive per lo sviluppo sostenibile, fornire accesso alla giustizia per tutti e costruire istituzioni efficaci, responsabili e inclusive a tutti i livelli) e l'SDG 17 (Rafforzare i mezzi di attuazione e rinnovare il partenariato mondiale per lo sviluppo sostenibile).

Voluntary contribution to ILO, organization devoted to promoting social justice and internationally recognized human and labour rights, pursuing its founding mission that social justice is essential to universal and lasting peace.The areas of work of the initiative are expanding access to and capabilities for productive and freely chosen employment and sustainable enterprise; strengthening just transitions and the social dimension of sustainable development, trade, and investment, social protection and building resilience; addressing inequality, discrimination and exclusion. It will also aid in realizing labour rights as human rights, ensuring human dignity and meeting basic needs; reinforcing institutions of social dialogue; labour migration; innovation and the development of technology partnerships.The contribution to the initiative is consistent with the implementation of the Agenda 2030, specifically SDG 4 (Ensure inclusive and equitable quality education and promote lifelong learning opportunities for all) targets 4.3 and 4.4; and SDG 8 (Promote sustained, inclusive and sustainable economic growth, full and productive employment and decent work for all), targets 8.5, 8.6, 8.7. The contribution will contribute to SDG 3 (Ensure healthy lives and promote well-being for all at all ages); SDG 5 (Achieve gender equality and empower all women and girls); SDG 9 (Build resilient infrastructure, promote inclusive and sustainable industrialization and foster innovation) and SDG 10 (Reduce inequality within and among countries). Other SDGs are SDG 12 (Ensure sustainable consumption and production patterns); SDG 16 (Promote peaceful and inclusive societies for sustainable development, provide access to justice for all and build effective, accountable and inclusive institutions at all levels) and SDG 17 (Strengthen the means of implementation and revitalize the global partnership for sustainable development).

tag.narrative: Achieve gender equality and empower all women and girls
Build resilient infrastructure, promote inclusive and sustainable industrialization and foster innovation
By 2030, ensure that all girls and boys complete free, equitable and quality primary and secondary education leading to relevant and effective learning outcomes
By 2030, progressively achieve and sustain income growth of the bottom 40 per cent of the population at a rate higher than the national average
By 2030, reduce the global maternal mortality ratio to less than 70 per 100,000 live births

Develop quality, reliable, sustainable and resilient infrastructure, including regional and transborder infrastructure, to support economic development and human well-being, with a focus on affordable and equitable access for all
End all forms of discrimination against all women and girls everywhere
Ensure healthy lives and promote well-being for all at all ages
Ensure inclusive and equitable quality education and promote lifelong learning opportunities for all
Ensure sustainable consumption and production patterns

Implement the 10-Year Framework of Programmes on Sustainable Consumption and Production Patterns, all countries taking action, with developed countries taking the lead, taking into account the development and capabilities of developing countries
Promote peaceful and inclusive societies for sustainable development, provide access to justice for all and build effective, accountable and inclusive institutions at all levels
Promote sustained, inclusive and sustainable economic growth, full and productive employment and decent work for all
Reduce inequality within and among countries
Significantly reduce all forms of violence and related death rates everywhere
Strengthen domestic resource mobilization, including through international support to developing countries, to improve domestic capacity for tax and other revenue collection
Strengthen the means of implementation and revitalize the global partnership for sustainable development
Sustain per capita economic growth in accordance with national circumstances and, in particular, at least 7 per cent gross domestic product growth per annum in the least developed countries
